activity.notes: Windradyne (c.1800–1829), a northern Wiradjuri man from the upper Macquarie River region, emerged as a key resistance leader during the conflict later known as the Bathurst Wars. The Australian Dictionary of Biography securely documents his central role from December 1823 through the martial-law crisis and his formal pardon in December 1824. ATLAS therefore records 1823–1824 as the core resistance-leadership interval and does not treat him as a sovereign chief or ruler of all Wiradjuri people.
